ja: ああ、だが彼はまるで彼自身ではなかった、

en: Or EveN suRe of wHo That wOuld EntAiL.
ja: それが誰を意味するのかすら、定かではなかったろうよ。

en: OuR riGhtfUl LeaDeR?
ja: 我らが正当なる指導者か?

en: If OnLy hE'd goTteN my wArnInG.

ja: 彼の執事は?

key: ToO fuSsed With hiS own IdeAlS.
en: ToO fuSsed With hiS own IdeAlS.

en: Do You FollOw my mEAning, LittLe hErO?

en: HoW loNg shOuld I Have toIled to eArn care eNough frOm a singlE one of tHem thaT I migHt be MisSeD?
ja: 誰か一人からでも、いなくなって寂しいと思われるほどの気遣いを得るのに、一体どれだけ骨を折るべきだったのだろうな?

key: As I've AlwaYs saiD, loyaLty is An ilLusIoN!
en: As I've AlwaYs saiD, loyaLty is An ilLusIoN!
ja: いつも言っている通り、忠誠心など幻想なのだよ!

en: BuT it Wasn'T untiL TitawIn stuck me Fast in The diGitaL woRlD--
ja: だが、ティタウィンが私をデジタルの世界に閉じ込めるまでは――

key: TrAppEd in A fireWall liKe the maiDen in tHe sawEd- boX trIcK,
en: TrAppEd in A fireWall liKe the maiDen in tHe sawEd- boX trIcK,

key: AlL thE whiLe watChing eVeryone I knew fOrget All aBouT mE...
en: AlL thE whiLe watChing eVeryone I knew fOrget All aBouT mE...
ja: その間ずっと、知り合い全員が私のことをすっかり忘れていくのを見ていた……

key: I dIdn'T reaLize uNtil thEn how muCh I nEeded to BelievE in thE lie MysElF.
en: I dIdn'T reaLize uNtil thEn how muCh I nEeded to BelievE in thE lie MysElF.
ja: その時になって初めて、自分自身がどれほどあのうそを信じる必要があったか、思い知ったのだよ。

key: AnD whAt elSe iS it, bUt a LiE?
en: AnD whAt elSe iS it, bUt a LiE?
ja: そして、それがうそでなくて何だというのだね?

key: ThEy sAy, be The chAnge you want To see In thE woRld, NoN?
en: ThEy sAy, be The chAnge you want To see In thE woRld, NoN?
ja: 世界に見たい変化があるなら、自分がその変化になれ、と言うだろう? ノン?

key: Be The FamiLy you wiShed To hAvE.
en: Be The FamiLy you wiShed To hAvE.
ja: 自分が望んでいた家族に、自分自身がなればいい、とね。

key: WeLl, I TrieD, and yOu knoW wherE thaT goT mE.
en: WeLl, I TrieD, and yOu knoW wherE thaT goT mE.
ja: まあ、試してはみたが、その結果がどうなったか、君にも分かるだろう。

key: So Now Let's Try somEthiNg eLsE.
en: So Now Let's Try somEthiNg eLsE.
ja: だから今度は、別のことを試してみようじゃないか。

key: To FacE the Truth Fully-- It's just a little too cold for me.
en: To FacE the Truth Fully-- It's just a little too cold for me.
ja: 真実に真正面から向き合うには――ここは私には、少々寒すぎるようだ。

key: ACE: Ah.
en: ACE: Ah.
ja: エース: ああ。

key: Well, that is better, isn't it?
en: Well, that is better, isn't it?
ja: さて、これでよくなったのではないかね?

key: And no wonder it was suddenly freezing.
en: And no wonder it was suddenly freezing.
ja: 急に凍えるように寒かったのも、道理というものだ。

key: Next time I get sucked into an otherworldly digital space-void, I'm going to have to insist that the god- adjacent child put me somewhere tropical.
en: Next time I get sucked into an otherworldly digital space-void, I'm going to have to insist that the god- adjacent child put me somewhere tropical.
ja: 次に異世界のデジタル空間の虚無に吸い込まれるようなことがあれば、あの神もどきの子供には、せめて熱帯地方に放り込んでもらうよう頼まねばなるまいな。

key: No matter.
en: No matter.
ja: まあ、どうでもいいことだ。

key: You have my gratitude, little hero, for rescuing me~
en: You have my gratitude, little hero, for rescuing me~
ja: 救い出してくれたこと、感謝するとしよう、小さな英雄よ～

key: A well deserved round of applause--
en: A well deserved round of applause--
ja: しかるべき拍手喝采を――

key: But first!
en: But first!
ja: だがその前に!

key: We've curses to end; reverses to mend!
en: We've curses to end; reverses to mend!
ja: 終わらせるべき呪いに、直すべき逆転劇があるとも!

key: ZERO: Uhhhh...
en: ZERO: Uhhhh...
ja: ゼロ: えーと……

key: Okay, this is happening.
en: Okay, this is happening.
ja: よし、まあこうなるよな。

key: Are you... yourself, Ace?
en: Are you... yourself, Ace?
ja: お前……本当にエースなのか?

key: ACE: Ah, how funny to hear that question from you~
en: ACE: Ah, how funny to hear that question from you~
ja: エース: ああ、その問いを君の口から聞くとは、なんとも愉快なことだねぇ〜

key: But I am properly in control of myself now, yes.
en: But I am properly in control of myself now, yes.
ja: だが、今の私はきちんと自分を制御できているとも、そうだ。

key: Apologies for... all of that.
en: Apologies for... all of that.
ja: その……先ほどのことは、わびておこう。

key: ZERO: Eh, I've had worse.
en: ZERO: Eh, I've had worse.
ja: ゼロ: いや、もっとひどいのも経験してるからな。

key: You were, uh...
en: You were, uh...
ja: お前はその、あー……

key: Really stuck like that watching everything for the entire time you were gone?
en: Really stuck like that watching everything for the entire time you were gone?
ja: 本当に、いなくなってた間ずっと、あんな風に閉じ込められて全部見てたのか?

key: ACE: Tautologically speaking, I think I must have been!
en: ACE: Tautologically speaking, I think I must have been!
ja: エース: 同語反復的に言えば、そうだったに違いないな!

key: However long that was.
en: However long that was.
ja: それがどれほどの長さだったにせよ。

key: It became something of a fugue, after a spell.
en: It became something of a fugue, after a spell.
ja: しばらくすると、それはある種のもうろう状態のようなものになっていった。

key: The sort of motion where you wake up for the fourth time in a day but you still aren't entirely sure what day it is.
en: The sort of motion where you wake up for the fourth time in a day but you still aren't entirely sure what day it is.
ja: 一日に四度も目を覚ましたのに、それが何日のことなのか、いまだにはっきりしない――そういう類の感覚だ。

key: Though, I was lucid enough for the start of it.
en: Though, I was lucid enough for the start of it.
ja: もっとも、最初のうちは、それなりに意識ははっきりしていたがね。

key: I remember all too keenly watching Titawin dump most of Magnezone's data like it was last week's leftover garbage.
en: I remember all too keenly watching Titawin dump most of Magnezone's data like it was last week's leftover garbage.
ja: ティタウィンがジバコイルのデータの大半を、先週の生ゴミか何かのように捨てるのを見ていたこと、あまりにも鮮明に覚えているよ。

key: I understood exactly what was going to happen when \PN fought it.
en: I understood exactly what was going to happen when \PN fought it.
ja: \PNがそれと戦ったとき、何が起きるのか、私には正確に分かっていた。

key: It was meant to kill you outright, you know?
en: It was meant to kill you outright, you know?
ja: 君を即座に殺すつもりだったんだ、分かるかね?

key: I had terribly limited access from the box I was in, but I'm glad that I was able to do enough to keep you alive.
en: I had terribly limited access from the box I was in, but I'm glad that I was able to do enough to keep you alive.
ja: 私が閉じ込められていた箱からは、ひどく限られたアクセスしかなかったが、それでも君を生かしておくのに十分なことができて、良かったと思っているよ。

key: ZERO: Wait, you saved my life from beyond the grave?
en: ZERO: Wait, you saved my life from beyond the grave?
ja: ゼロ: 待て、お前、墓の向こうから俺の命を救ってたのか?

key: ACE: It was really more of a digital prison than a beyond-the-grave type of situation, but...
en: ACE: It was really more of a digital prison than a beyond-the-grave type of situation, but...
ja: エース: 実際のところ、墓の向こうというより、デジタルの独房といった方が近いのだがね……

key: Sure, you can believe that if you'd like!
en: Sure, you can believe that if you'd like!
ja: まあ、君がそう信じたいなら、それでも構わないとも!

key: Arguably, I did twice!
en: Arguably, I did twice!
ja: 議論の余地はあるが、二度もやってのけたのだからな!

key: How's that for magic?
en: How's that for magic?
ja: これぞ魔法、といったところではないかね?

key: ZERO: ...Twice?
en: ZERO: ...Twice?
ja: ゼロ: ……二度?

key: ACE: In Labradorra, if you recall?
en: ACE: In Labradorra, if you recall?
ja: エース: ラブラドラでのこと、覚えているかね?

key: I was able to push access over to that other girl-- Florinia, it was.
en: I was able to push access over to that other girl-- Florinia, it was.
ja: あの娘――フロリニアだったか――に、アクセス権を押し出してやることができたのだよ。

key: She did most of the heavy lifting, but she wouldn't have gotten her proverbial foot in the digital door if it weren't for me.
en: She did most of the heavy lifting, but she wouldn't have gotten her proverbial foot in the digital door if it weren't for me.
ja: 重労働の大半は彼女がこなしたが、私がいなければ、彼女はデジタルの扉に、いわゆる片足すら踏み入れられなかっただろうよ。

key: But, let us simply consider you pulling me out of there to be fair payback!
en: But, let us simply consider you pulling me out of there to be fair payback!
ja: まあ、君が私をあそこから引っ張り出してくれたことで、これは公平な恩返しということにしておこうか!

key: All in all, I simply lament that I couldn't do more.
en: All in all, I simply lament that I couldn't do more.
ja: つまるところ、もっと多くをなせなかったことを、ただ嘆くばかりだよ。

key: But that's user permissions for you!
en: But that's user permissions for you!
ja: だが、それがユーザー権限というものだからな!

key: That and networking are always the grandest nightmares to deal in.
en: That and networking are always the grandest nightmares to deal in.
ja: それとネットワーク周りは、いつだって最も厄介な悪夢というものだ。

key: ZERO: Well, thanks...
en: ZERO: Well, thanks...
ja: ゼロ: まあ、ありがとな……

key: Uh, I kinda feel like I should've saved you a little harder here to make up for it.
en: Uh, I kinda feel like I should've saved you a little harder here to make up for it.
ja: その、埋め合わせに、もうちょっと頑張ってお前を助けるべきだったんじゃないかって気がしてきた。

key: ACE: No no no, none of that!
en: ACE: No no no, none of that!
ja: エース: いやいやいや、そんなことはない!

key: You've done plenty perfectly already, and to be plain, I'm just glad to see you standing on your own two feet!
en: You've done plenty perfectly already, and to be plain, I'm just glad to see you standing on your own two feet!
ja: 君はすでに十分すぎるほどやってくれた、それに率直に言えば、君が自分の足でしっかり立っているのを見られて、ただうれしいのだよ!

key: Though if you really do want to make it up to me better, there is one problem we can deal with at once:
en: Though if you really do want to make it up to me better, there is one problem we can deal with at once:
ja: もっとも、本当に埋め合わせをしたいというのなら、一度に片付けられる問題がひとつ、あるにはあるがね――

key: TAKA: Ah...
en: TAKA: Ah...
ja: タカ: あ……

key: And we're back, I guess.
en: And we're back, I guess.
ja: また戻ってきた、ってことなのかな。

key: And we're back.
en: And we're back.
ja: また戻ってきたね。

key: ACE: My sincerest apologies, little prince.
en: ACE: My sincerest apologies, little prince.
ja: エース: 心からのわびを、小さな王子よ。

key: TAKA: It's, uh, all right?
en: TAKA: It's, uh, all right?
ja: タカ: それは、その、大丈夫だよ?

key: I'm sorry, for the record.
en: I'm sorry, for the record.
ja: 念のため言っておくけど、僕の方こそごめん。

key: I didn't know what happened.
en: I didn't know what happened.
ja: 何が起きたのか、分かってなかったんだ。

key: Though, even if I did...
en: Though, even if I did...
ja: もっとも、分かっていたとしても……

key: ACE: There was little to be done about the rampaging child deity, I know.
en: ACE: There was little to be done about the rampaging child deity, I know.
ja: エース: 暴れ回る子供の神様相手には、できることなどほとんどなかった、それは分かっているとも。

key: Let alone her tumultuous pet dinosaur.
en: Let alone her tumultuous pet dinosaur.
ja: ましてや、あの手に負えないペットの恐竜については、なおさらだ。

key: ...I'd tried to help in the little ways I could from the box I was in.
en: ...I'd tried to help in the little ways I could from the box I was in.
ja: ……私は、あの箱の中から、自分にできるささやかな方法で助けようとしたのだよ。

key: In Labradorra, if you recall?
en: In Labradorra, if you recall?
ja: ラブラドラでのこと、覚えているかね?

key: TAKA: Huh?
en: TAKA: Huh?
ja: タカ: え?

key: ACE: I was able to push access over to that other girl-- Florinia, it was.
en: ACE: I was able to push access over to that other girl-- Florinia, it was.
ja: エース: あの娘――フロリニアだったか――に、アクセス権を押し出してやることができたのだよ。

key: ...I simply find myself thankful that it wasn't for naught if I'm able to stand here and see you once more, little prince.
en: ...I simply find myself thankful that it wasn't for naught if I'm able to stand here and see you once more, little prince.
ja: ……こうしてここに立ち、君に再び会えたのだから、あれが無駄ではなかったのだと、ただ感謝するばかりだよ、小さな王子。

key: No, I will not be accepting any apologies at this time.
en: No, I will not be accepting any apologies at this time.
ja: いや、今この時ばかりは、いかなるわびも受け付けないとも。

key: TAKA: No, I understand.
en: TAKA: No, I understand.
ja: タカ: ううん、分かるよ。

key: \PN had to pull me from the same sort of mess.
en: \PN had to pull me from the same sort of mess.
ja: \PNも、僕を同じような窮地から引っ張り出してくれたんだ。

key: I'm just happy you're back.
en: I'm just happy you're back.
ja: 君が戻ってきてくれて、それだけでうれしい。

key: ACE: Awh, you do care!
en: ACE: Awh, you do care!
ja: エース: おや、ちゃんと気にかけてくれているのだね!

key: And you seem no worse for the wear!
en: And you seem no worse for the wear!
ja: それに、少しもやつれた様子がないではないか!

key: TAKA: I'm sorry it took us so long to find you.
en: TAKA: I'm sorry it took us so long to find you.
ja: タカ: 見つけるのに、こんなに時間がかかっちゃってごめん。

key: We didn't have any idea what happened, and...
en: We didn't have any idea what happened, and...
ja: 何が起きたのか、僕らには全然分からなくて、それで……

key: Well, I'm not terribly proud of my actions back then.
en: Well, I'm not terribly proud of my actions back then.
ja: まあ、あの頃の自分の行動を、あんまり誇りには思えないんだけど。

key: ACE: But that just goes to show you've grown!
en: ACE: But that just goes to show you've grown!
ja: エース: だが、それこそが君の成長の証というものだよ!

key: No no no no, I will not be accepting any apologies from you at this time!
en: No no no no, I will not be accepting any apologies from you at this time!
ja: いやいやいやいや、今この時ばかりは、君からのいかなるわびも受け付けないとも!

key: Especially not for whatever mumbo jumbo I muttered under the spell of the hocus pocus smoke.
en: Especially not for whatever mumbo jumbo I muttered under the spell of the hocus pocus smoke.
ja: ましてや、あのまやかしの煙の魔法にかかって、私が何をぶつぶつつぶやいていたにせよ、な。

key: Let us both simply be thankful that we've been able to properly reunite here!
en: Let us both simply be thankful that we've been able to properly reunite here!
ja: こうしてちゃんと再会できたことを、二人ともただ感謝しようではないか!

key: Even if the whole team has been unravelled--
en: Even if the whole team has been unravelled--
ja: たとえ、あの一団が丸ごとほどけて崩れてしまったのだとしても――

key: As I'm afraid I had the displeasure of helplessly watching it all--
en: As I'm afraid I had the displeasure of helplessly watching it all--
ja: 私は、あいにくそれを何もできずに見ているという不愉快な役目を負っていたわけだが――

key: At least we have our minds and health.
en: At least we have our minds and health.
ja: 少なくとも、私たちには正気と健康が残っている。

key: TAKA: And our freedom.
en: TAKA: And our freedom.
ja: タカ: それに、自由もね。

key: Now we can make our own choices.
en: Now we can make our own choices.
ja: これからは、自分たちで選択できる。

key: Things like... what kind of family we want to be.
en: Things like... what kind of family we want to be.
ja: たとえば……僕らがどんな家族になりたいか、とかね。

key: ACE: Ah, must we drivel on with all of that still?
en: ACE: Ah, must we drivel on with all of that still?
ja: エース: ああ、まだそんなたわ言を続けなければならないのかね?

key: TAKA: It's okay.
en: TAKA: It's okay.
ja: タカ: 大丈夫だよ。

key: I mean, I know it wasn't quite you, but...
en: I mean, I know it wasn't quite you, but...
ja: その、あれが本当のエースじゃなかったのは分かってるけど……

key: There's still something there, right?
en: There's still something there, right?
ja: それでも、何かは残ってるんだよね?

key: I was really grateful that you went out of your way for me at the time.
en: I was really grateful that you went out of your way for me at the time.
ja: あのとき、僕のためにわざわざそこまでしてくれたこと、本当に感謝してるんだ。

key: I don't exactly know how, but I'd like to make it up to you.
en: I don't exactly know how, but I'd like to make it up to you.
ja: どうやってかは分からないけど、埋め合わせをしたいと思ってる。

key: I'm happy you're back.
en: I'm happy you're back.
ja: 戻ってきてくれて、うれしいよ。

key: Uh, I guess what I'm trying to say is,
en: Uh, I guess what I'm trying to say is,
ja: えっと、僕が言いたいのは、

key: Even though Team Meteor is over,
en: Even though Team Meteor is over,
ja: チームメテオはもう終わったけど、

key: You can still be my family.
en: You can still be my family.
ja: それでも君は、僕の家族でいてくれていいんだ。

key: I missed you.
en: I missed you.
ja: 会いたかったよ。

key: ACE: Awh, little prince, you're as kind as ever.
en: ACE: Awh, little prince, you're as kind as ever.
ja: エース: ああ、小さな王子よ、君は相変わらず優しいのだね。

key: Only now with the room to grow it and show it!
en: Only now with the room to grow it and show it!
ja: しかも今は、それを育て、示す余裕まであるというわけだ!

key: What a happy ending I've fallen into.
en: What a happy ending I've fallen into.
ja: なんとも幸福な結末に、私は転がり込んだものだよ。

key: Perhaps I should thank our local petulant god-child after all.
en: Perhaps I should thank our local petulant god-child after all.
ja: 結局のところ、あの短気な神もどきの子供にも、礼を言うべきなのかもしれないな。

key: TAKA: Let's not go that far.
en: TAKA: Let's not go that far.
ja: タカ: そこまではしなくていいよ。

key: ACE: Still, I'll tell you what I'm not thankful for--
en: ACE: Still, I'll tell you what I'm not thankful for--
ja: エース: とはいえ、感謝していないことを、一つ教えてやろう――

key: TAKA: Ace.
en: TAKA: Ace.
ja: タカ: エース。

key: I know firsthand that when it comes to these things, there has to be a spark to light the fire.
en: I know firsthand that when it comes to these things, there has to be a spark to light the fire.
ja: こういうことには、火をつける火花が必要だって、僕は身をもって知ってるんだ。

key: Know that, while Team Meteor may have been undone,
en: Know that, while Team Meteor may have been undone,
ja: チームメテオが解体されたとしても、これだけは分かっておいてほしい、

key: You're still my family.
en: You're still my family.
ja: 君はまだ、僕の家族だってこと。

key: We'll do better by you in the future too.
en: We'll do better by you in the future too.
ja: これからは、もっと君に応えられるようにするから。

key: Understood?
en: Understood?
ja: 分かった?

key: ACE: Ahah.
en: ACE: Ahah.
ja: エース: あはは。

key: I could just blush.
en: I could just blush.
ja: 赤面してしまいそうだよ。

key: Very well, little prince--
en: Very well, little prince--
ja: よろしい、小さな王子よ――

key: Ah, but perhaps by now it should be little king?
en: Ah, but perhaps by now it should be little king?
ja: ああ、だが今となっては、小さな王、と呼ぶべきかな?

key: TAKA: No, let's keep it as it is.
en: TAKA: No, let's keep it as it is.
ja: タカ: ううん、このままでいいよ。

key: Just for now, at least.
en: Just for now, at least.
ja: 少なくとも、今はまだ。

key: Too much has changed already.
en: Too much has changed already.
ja: もう十分、色々変わりすぎたから。

key: ACE: As you wish~
en: ACE: As you wish~
ja: エース: 望み通りに〜

key: Now, speaking of things that haven't changed--
en: Now, speaking of things that haven't changed--
ja: さて、変わっていないものと言えば――

key: This awful chill.
en: This awful chill.
ja: この忌々しい寒さだ。

key: Might we quit this place?
en: Might we quit this place?
ja: そろそろこの場所を後にしないかね?

key: ZERO: Sounds good to me.
en: ZERO: Sounds good to me.
ja: ゼロ: 賛成だ。

key: You coming with?
en: You coming with?
ja: 一緒に来るか?

key: ZERO: Cool. Let's hurry.
en: ZERO: Cool. Let's hurry.
ja: ゼロ: よし。急ぐぞ。

key: ZERO: You know best, I guess.
en: ZERO: You know best, I guess.
ja: ゼロ: お前が一番分かってるんだろうな。

key: I'll see you back at the club.
en: I'll see you back at the club.
ja: クラブでまた会おう。

key: TAKA: Yeah, for sure.
en: TAKA: Yeah, for sure.
ja: タカ: うん、もちろん。

key: Are we all leaving together?
en: Are we all leaving together?
ja: みんな一緒に出るの?

key: TAKA: Of course.
en: TAKA: Of course.
ja: タカ: もちろん。

key: Shall we all go together?
en: Shall we all go together?
ja: みんなで一緒に行こうか?

key: TAKA: Sounds good to me.
en: TAKA: Sounds good to me.
ja: タカ: いいと思うよ。

key: ...Though I gotta say, I'm not looking forward to seeing all the Sunkern on the way out.
en: ...Though I gotta say, I'm not looking forward to seeing all the Sunkern on the way out.
ja: ……でも正直、帰り道でまたあのヒマナッツを見るのは気が進まないな。

key: That thing kinda hurt for such a little guy...
en: That thing kinda hurt for such a little guy...
ja: あんなに小さいのに、結構痛かったし……

key: ACE: Sunkern?
en: ACE: Sunkern?
ja: エース: ヒマナッツ?

key: Here?
en: Here?
ja: ここに?

key: TAKA: Uh...
en: TAKA: Uh...
ja: タカ: えっと……

key: Don't worry about it.
en: Don't worry about it.
ja: 気にしないで。

key: TAKA: As you like.
en: TAKA: As you like.
ja: タカ: 好きにして。

key: Stay safe out here.
en: Stay safe out here.
ja: 外では気をつけて。

key: Don't let the small angry children bite.
en: Don't let the small angry children bite.
ja: 怒れる小さい子供たちにかまれないようにね。

key: KyyaaaAAAaAagh!!!
en: KyyaaaAAAaAagh!!!
ja: キャアァァァアァグ!!!

key: KYUREM: Raaaaagh!
en: KYUREM: Raaaaagh!
ja: キュレム: ラァァァグ!

key: ZERO: That was the last of them, right?
en: ZERO: That was the last of them, right?
ja: ゼロ: あれで最後だよな?

key: I guess that about wraps it up for this place.
en: I guess that about wraps it up for this place.
ja: これでこの場所も、一段落ってところか。

key: It's good to know that I can play support both behind the desk and on the field well enough.
en: It's good to know that I can play support both behind the desk and on the field well enough.
ja: デスクの裏でも、現場でも、それなりにサポート役を果たせるって分かったのはよかったな。

key: ...But time to get back to it.
en: ...But time to get back to it.
ja: ……でも、そろそろ戻る時間か。

key: Ideally before she--
en: Ideally before she--
ja: できれば、あいつが――になる前に――

key: TAKA: Got 'em all?
en: TAKA: Got 'em all?
ja: タカ: 全部捕まえた?

key: I'd expect nothing less from the Champion.
en: I'd expect nothing less from the Champion.
ja: チャンピオンなら、それくらい当然だよね。

key: If we're all done, let's get out of here.
en: If we're all done, let's get out of here.
ja: 全部終わったなら、ここを出よう。

key: I may be just a guy, but I've been thinking I'm a pretty lucky one.
en: I may be just a guy, but I've been thinking I'm a pretty lucky one.
ja: 僕はただの一人の人間だけど、結構運がいい方だと思うんだ。

key: It hasn't always been a fun time, but I guess not too many people get to go through everything I have and live to tell about it.
en: It hasn't always been a fun time, but I guess not too many people get to go through everything I have and live to tell about it.
ja: いつも楽しかったわけじゃないけど、僕が経験してきた全部を経て、それを語れるくらい生き延びられる人って、そう多くないと思うから。

key: I'm looking forward to being able to decide what comes next.
en: I'm looking forward to being able to decide what comes next.
ja: この先を自分で決められることが、楽しみなんだ。

key: No idea what that'll be, but at least I can choose it for myself.
en: No idea what that'll be, but at least I can choose it for myself.
ja: それが何になるかは分からないけど、少なくとも自分で選べる。

key: That's more than I ever had before.
en: That's more than I ever had before.
ja: それだけでも、今までの僕にはなかったことだから。

key: And getting to hang out with the Champion is always a nice bonus, you know?
en: And getting to hang out with the Champion is always a nice bonus, you know?
ja: それに、チャンピオンと一緒に過ごせるのは、いつだってうれしいおまけだよね?

key: But if we're all done, let's get out of here.
en: But if we're all done, let's get out of here.
ja: でも、全部終わったなら、ここを出よう。

key: If we stay much longer we might catch a cold.
en: If we stay much longer we might catch a cold.
ja: あんまり長居すると、風邪を引いちゃうかも。

key: ...Or something worse.
en: ...Or something worse.
ja: ……それか、もっと悪い何かに。

key: ACE: I think I must have been!
en: ACE: I think I must have been!
ja: エース: そうだったに違いないな!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
